caption:
One point on your mortgage rate = $232 a month. 🏠
On a $350,000 30-year loan, 7.21% (this week's Freddie Mac average) costs about $2,378 a month in principal and interest. At 6.21% it's about $2,146.
That's roughly $2,787 a year.
Would a lower rate change your plans?
first_comment: Are you waiting on rates, or buying anyway? 👇
